title: Brown hypotheses on Noetherian schemes reduce to compactness
statement: Let ℓ be prime, X a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme, and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring satisfying the six-case predicate of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put S=Dctf(X,Λ) and L=Loc(S). BrownHypothesesFor Λ X, as characterized in [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion], is equivalent to the existence of a fixed-universe coproduct structure on L for which every K in L with underlying object in S is compact [def-pc-compact-object]. No field or separatedness hypothesis on X is imposed. This equivalence does not assert compactness.

proof.text: Unpack the actual six-case admissibility predicate. Its finite, integral and rational alternatives are exactly those of the smallness theorem, after permuting the disjunction. For finite carriers use the proved explicit ULift ring-object isomorphism; unused finite-ring and extension parameters are the zero ring and bottom extension. Apply det_brown_hypotheses_small to the compact locally Noetherian scheme. This proves thickness, repleteness, retract closure and essential smallness without assuming X is of finite type over a field.

Apply the forward formal Brown criterion to extract coproducts and objectwise compactness. Conversely combine those hypotheses with the thickness and smallness established in the previous step and apply the reverse criterion. Generation and the ambient structures are supplied by that criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem brownHypothesesFor_iff_compact_of_noetherian
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ) :
    BrownHypothesesFor Λ X ↔
      ∃ hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1} (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
        letI := hSums
        ∀ K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
          (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
            DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) → IsCompactObject K
